# cpanel_email_account_suspension (Data Source)

Looks up login, incoming-mail, and outgoing-mail suspension status for a cPanel email account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "cpanel_email_account_suspension" "mailbox" {
  email = "terraform@example.com"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `email` (String) The complete existing email account address.

### Read-Only

- `has_suspended` (Boolean) Whether cPanel reports any suspension or outgoing-mail hold for the account.
- `incoming_suspended` (Boolean) Whether cPanel rejects incoming mail for the account.
- `login_suspended` (Boolean) Whether cPanel has suspended mailbox login.
- `outgoing_held` (Boolean) Whether outgoing mail is held in the Exim queue. This provider reports but does not manage held mail.
- `outgoing_suspended` (Boolean) Whether cPanel rejects outgoing mail for the account.
